name: Grafana
summary: Push Ogun run and approval events to Grafana Loki, on Grafana Cloud or a self-hosted server, with the push API at /loki/api/v1/push.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Username
fields.help: For Grafana Cloud, the Loki user ID of the stack.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: For Grafana Cloud, an access policy token that may write logs. Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Loki host
settings.help: Host only. Grafana Cloud shows it on the stack's Loki details page.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: 443 for Grafana Cloud or behind TLS; 3100 is the default of a self-hosted Loki.

settings.name: tenant_id
settings.label: Tenant ID
settings.help: Sent as X-Scope-OrgID, for a multi-tenant Loki.

settings.name: job
settings.label: Job label
settings.help: Value of the job label on every pushed stream.

notes: Loki receives the events as log lines: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person. The metrics (ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state) are for the Prometheus and OpenTelemetry connectors. A read-only query bridge for Grafana (ADR 0012) is planned, not built.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
